tiktok.caption: Your budget might actually be making you spend MORE money. Here's the one-switch fix that works without tracking a thing.

youtube_short.title: The Budget That Makes You Spend MORE
title_alternatives: Why Budgeting Makes 80% of People Spend More
youtube_short.description: Here's something no finance guru wants to admit: traditional category budgets make most people spend more, not less. When you write '$400 for food,' your brain reads that as permission — not a ceiling. Studies show spending in budgeted categories jumps up to 20% above what people were spending before. Then 80% quit within three months, and even after quitting they're spending $3,360 more per year than if they'd never started. The fix is reverse budgeting — move savings automatically on payday, then spend whatever's left guilt-free. No categories, no tracking, 34% more saved. Follow for money truths that actually change things. #budgeting #personalfinance #moneypsychology #savemoney #financetips

hook_line: Your budget is making you spend MORE
